# Stage 7 – Microservices

1. ## Create hierarchical maven project structure:

```
lms-microservices
├── lms-parent
│    └── pom.xml    <-- parent for everything 
├── microservice-parent
│    └── pom.xml    <-- parent for microservices (extends lms-parent)
├── starter-parent
│    └── pom.xml    <-- parent for Spring Boot starters (extends lms-parent)
├── starter-test
│    └── pom.xml    <-- (extends starter-parent)
├── student-service
│    └── pom.xml    <-- (extends microservice-parent)
...
```

2. ## Create microservices:

   1. **Approuter** – application entry point

   2. ## **Subscription microservice** – provides API and logic for tenant onboarding/offboarding

   3. ## **Student microservice** – provides API and logic for Student domain

   4. **Course microservice** – provides API and logic for Course domain  
   5. **Email microservice** – responsible for sending emails  
3. Create custom Spring Boot starter for tests (starter-test), which will contain marker annotations for unit and integration tests  
4. Create custom Spring Boot starter for SAP BTP Feature Flags Service (starter-feature-flags)  
5. Add starter in microservices

6. ## Add RabbitMQ to communication between services

### **Achievements**

1. Spring Boot Cloud modules  
2. Spring Boot starters  
3. Maven inheritance  
4. Dependencies management  
5. Plugins management  
6. BOM  
7. Message brokers  
8. AMQP protocol  
9. RabbitMQ  
10. Library vs Starter
